title: Crossbow Bow
description: Adds continuity between the crossbow and bow texture.
body:
# Unified Bow & Crossbow Textures
Overview
This texture pack creates a cohesive visual experience by redesigning the bow texture to match the aesthetic of the crossbow. No more jarring texture inconsistencies—now your projectile weapons feel like they belong in the same arsenal.

![bow](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cd2e54dc31730d8864c6867855763f25e51e7f1d_0.webp)
## Features
Bow Redesign - New bow texture based on crossbow assets for  continuity

Consistent Aesthetic - Similar design between the crossbow and the bow
